title: Purdue University Libraries Campus GIS building footprint

feature_identifier.Name: Maurice G. Knoy Hall of Technology

source_date: Not stated. The service response has a ChangeYear attribute, which is retained as a separate source field and is not treated as a publication date.
source_crs: EPSG:4326 (requested in the query; returned in the raw response)
comparison_method: Apply the project local approximation X=(longitude+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)), Y=(latitude-40.4274)*111040, then subtract the asset-local XY origin (218.3895, 44.12) m and compare ordered boundary vertices to the reopened KNOY_Footprint_Reference_Wire mesh.
comparison_result: The saved boundary matches the separate project cache within 0.000012 m after local translation. Comparison against this live service response has a maximum 0.177865 m vertex difference at two adjacent points; see validation_r23.json for all point residuals.
uncertainty: The local transform is an approximate tangent-plane conversion, not survey control. The service/cache mismatch may reflect source edits or separate digitization; no structural-wall offset is inferred from it.
identifier_reconciliation: The separate project cache modular/buildings/target_buildings_gis.json calls its Knoy row FID 243 and stores levels/extrusion fields. That FID is not the Purdue campus service OBJECTID, which is 189 for Knoy. Both identifiers are preserved explicitly; the two sources should not be conflated.
